subject: spanish

moments.title: Mexican independence struggle begins
moments.body: Hidalgo's 'Grito de Dolores' on 16 September 1810 ignites Mexican independence.
moments.takeaway: Latin American independence was triggered by Spain's Napoleonic crisis.

moments.title: Bolivar at Boyaca
moments.body: Bolivar's victory at Boyaca cements his role as Latin American liberator.

moments.title: Bolivar dies
moments.body: Bolivar's dream of a unified Gran Colombia collapses; he dies disillusioned.
moments.takeaway: Liberators do not always like what comes next.

now.title: Bolivar's legacy
now.body: Bolivar's image remains central in Venezuela and Colombia. The Bolivarian Revolution rebranded politics in 21st-century Venezuela.

reflection: Most of today's Latin American nations were Spanish colonies until the 1820s.
